en: No sign of the final explosives shipment to the west either.  Where are those lollygaggers?
Keep the door closed, $C.  Never know when the Dark Riders will be passing through again.

I see you know more of the secret of steel than I do. That is good, for it is meant to be taken. Now you must travel to the jungle south of the human lands, to the goblin city of Booty Bay. There you will find a Goblin named Brikk Keencraft. I do not like Goblins but his knowledge of the secret of steel is unmatched by any I know of.
Greetings, $c.
We spent so much of our lives in flight, memories of peaceful times grow evermore distant.
I'll just label it for reference then dig it up.
Help! Wait! It's like this thing has a mind of its own!
You don't look like much to me, but who knows, maybe there's an enchanter hidden in there somewhere!
Ah, this must be him now... no?  Bah!
|cffffff00Crown Guard Tower has been taken by the Alliance!|r
I'm afraid ye would not survive long in Alterac Valley, $c.  Come back and see us when you have a few more seasons under your belt.
Usurpers! Gnomeregan is mine!
%s becomes exhausted!
Stop giving me that look. I may not be an adventurer like you, but that doesn't mean I can't have a few muscles. All that stirring makes your arms strong.
In position!
Over there! Can it be?
Greetings, $c.  Welcome to Cenarion Hold.  From here we will strike against the silithid where they're at their strongest.  I hope you've come to lend a hand.
Jarad, you are up first for us.
Hey, that's actually not so bad. Alrighty, then. How'd you like to run an errand for me?
Give of your hearts and your purses! Give to the children of Stormwind who have lost their parents.
What is it that you want, lemming? Get out of my sight before you find out why I am known as the Wrathcaster.
A moment I shall remember for always.
There's one in Orgrimmar.  A grunt up there will know what directions to give you.  Just head north up the road here, you can't miss it.
The Scourge attack against my court has been eliminated.  You may go about your business.
Well $glad : lass;, ye can find Shelby Stoneflint right outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.  She'll take good care of any pets ye might have.
You'll need to prove your worthiness before I go giving away my secrets! I've got just the test for you...
You're looking for Tai'jin.  Find her in the barracks on the east side of town.
You think you have guts?  Well I have something for you if you do...
Seize him! Seize the worthless criminal and his allies!
Just leave the poor man alone, citizen, he's not worth the trouble.
%s comes to rest as it begins to release the counter agent into the air.
Ach, it's hard enough keeping order around here without all these new troubles popping up!  I hope you have good news, $n...
Grumnus be your man, $n. He'll school you in the art of the armorsmith.
Where is Elder Farwhisper?
I will do this with or without your help, Loramus.
That explosion was great! Did you see how big it was?
What?! How dare you!
Many are the paths of the Earth Mother.  Wherever you decide to travel, may she watch over you.
Tell me a story, Skorn.
Amazing! I feel... renewed. My strength returns!

The Ashbringer is dead and there will never be another like him. The lesser Mograine is a far cry from the man his father was. You know this, Commander! It was, after all, your own leadership that was responsible for the death of the Scarlet Highlord Mograine.
Please tell me that you didn't just do what I think you just did. Please tell me that I'm not going to have to hurt you...
Enjoy your small victory while you can, mortals. It will not stop our eventual triumph over this land!
Join the fight against evil!  Accept a commission within the Argent Dawn today!
It's good to see an engineer brave enough to make the device.   We goblin engineers laugh at danger!
Our freedom would have meant nothing if C'Thun had survived. You are truly a champion of prophecy.
Don't make me go medieval on you.
I will not die again! Not to the likes of you!!
I will tear off your limbs and use them to beat you into submission!
Good work, soldier. I need to get back to base camp! Will you cover me?
